name: Origin
description: Writes this Gateway's agent sessions to Origin, a cross-agent personal memory, as event lines: into a directory an Origin device reads, or to your Origin hub. With a hub, it gives the agents Origin's read tools.

hub.label: Hub URL
hub.help: Your Origin hub, such as https://hub.example.com. Set this or dir.

token.label: Hub token
token.help: A token created on the hub with origin token create <name>; a SecretRef is resolved by the Gateway.

tokenEnv.label: Hub token variable
tokenEnv.help: The name of an environment variable of the Gateway that holds the hub token, instead of token.

dir.label: Directory
dir.help: A directory an Origin device on this host reads, such as ~/.origin/sources/openclaw. Set this or hub.

source.label: Source name
source.help: The source the lines are recorded under in Origin.

agents.label: Agents
agents.help: The ids of the agents to record; all agents when unset.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.help: The kinds of runs to record, such as user, cron, heartbeat; only user turns by default.

projectBy.label: Project by
projectBy.help: Name each session's project after its agent or its channel.

project.label: Project
project.help: One project name for every session, instead of projectBy.

reconcileOnEnd.label: Reconcile on session end
reconcileOnEnd.help: Read the end of an ended session's transcript and send what was missed. Needs conversation access.

tools.label: Origin tools for agents
tools.help: When the agents get Origin's read tools (origin_brief, origin_search, origin_get, origin_timeline, origin_digest), which your hub answers with the hub token: owner-turns (default) in every turn OpenClaw's owner starts, in direct chats, groups, channels, and threads; owner-private only in turns OpenClaw resolves as its owner's private memory audience; off never. Only with a hub.

spoolDir.label: State directory
spoolDir.help: Where undelivered lines and the record of sent ones are kept.
